claim: Statista's Apple Pay revenue chart (statistics/1060577), the source most frequently cited by downstream blog aggregators, is itself sourced entirely from a single February 21, 2019 Loup Ventures estimate and has not been refreshed with newer data.
stance_target: provenance of widely-cited Apple Pay revenue statistics
quoted_support: Loup Ventures. (February 21, 2019). Global Apple Pay revenue worldwide in 2019, with a forecast for 2023 (in million U.S. dollars) [Graph]. In Statista.
